title: FenceState
description: MQTT payload for fence/<node_id>/state — authoritative contract shared by firmware, ingest, and mock publisher.

node_id.description: Opaque topic-safe node identifier. Must agree with the MQTT topic segment. Not assumed to be a MAC or fixed-width hex.

kv.description: Advisory on-node kV estimate; backend recomputes from adc_mv at query time

adc_mv.description: Peak fence ADC reading in millivolts — measurement of record

rssi.description: Wi-Fi RSSI in dBm at association time

boot.description: Monotonic wake counter; resets to 0 on power loss

failed_pub.description: Cumulative publish failures since boot; resets with boot

wifi_ms.description: Milliseconds from Wi-Fi begin to association

ts.description: Reserved: UTC epoch seconds when the reading was taken

report_interval_s.description: Reserved: routine heartbeat interval in seconds

sample_interval_s.description: Reserved: fence sampling interval in seconds
